title: 49 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Success)
description:
Learn 49 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 49 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Success · Mafanikio
1:22  Shopping & Prices · Ununuzi na Bei
2:32  Love · Upendo
4:03  Hope · Tumaini
5:18  Celebrations & Parties · Sherehe na Mikutano
6:35  Courage · Ujasiri
7:53  Strength · Nguvu
9:11  Feelings & Emotions · Hisia na Machozi

PHRASE LIST

SUCCESS · Mafanikio
• I’m ready for bigger wins. - Niko tayari kwa mafanikio makubwa zaidi.  [NIKO tayari kwa MAfanIKIO makubwa ZAIDI.]
• Today I lead, not fear. - Leo naongoza, si hofu.  [LEO naONgoza, si HOFU.]
• I practice, then I improve. - Nafanya mazoezi, kisha naimarika.  [NANafanya maZOEzi, KISHA naIMARIKA.]
• I set standards and meet them. - Naweka viwango, navifikia.  [NAweka VIwango, naVIFIKIA.]
• No more waiting, I act. - Sitasubiri tena, naanza hatua.  [SItaSBTIri tena, naANza HAta.]
• My consistency is my superpower. - Uthabiti wangu ndio nguvu yangu.  [UTHAbiti wangu NDIO NguvU yangu.]

SHOPPING & PRICES · Ununuzi na Bei
• Do you have this in my size? - Unalo hicho kwa ukubwa wangu?  [U-nalo hicho kwa u-kuubwa wangu?]
• How much is the cheapest option? - Bei yake ya chini kabisa ni ipi?  [Bei yake ya chini KA-bisa ni pi?]
• What are the payment options? - Una njia gani za kulipa?  [Una njia gani za ku-LI-pa?]
• Is there a student discount? - Mnatoa punguzo kwa wanafunzi?  [M-na-toa pun-GU-zo kwa wa-NA-funzi?]
• Does it include free delivery? - Inajumuisha usafiri wa bure?  [I-na-ju-MU-lisha u-SA-fi-ri wa BU-re?]
• How long does delivery take? - Usafirishaji unachukua muda gani?  [U-sa-fi-ri-sha-ji un-a-CHU-ku-a mu-da gani?]

LOVE · Upendo
• I trust your love, truly - Ninaamini upendo wako, kweli  [NINAAMINI uPENDO wako, KWELI]
• Your patience makes my heart calm - Uvumilivu wako unaituliza moyo wangu  [uVUMILIVU wako unaITULIZA MOYO wangu]
• When I fall, you lift me - Nikidondoka, unanipandisha juu  [NIKI dondOKA, unaNIPANDISHA juu]
• We laugh, and it feels like home - Tunakocheka, na inahisi kama nyumbani  [tuNAKOcheka, na inaHISI kama NYUMBANI]
• I choose your warmth, over everything - Ninachagua joto lako, kuliko kila kitu  [NINACHAGUA JOTO lako, KUdi kuliko kila kitu]
• Your voice calms the noise in me - Sauti yako inaleta utulivu ndani yangu  [SAUTI yako inaLETA uTULIVU ndani yangu]
• I want to grow old with you - Nataka kuzeeka pamoja na wewe  [NAtaKA KUZEeka pamoja na WEWE]

HOPE · Tumaini
• Hope is my morning breath. - Tumaini ndicho pumzi yangu ya asubuhi.  [TuMAINi ndio CHANZI cha pumzi yangu ya asubuhi.]
• I text, hoping you feel it. - Ninatuma ujumbe, nikitarajia utaihisi.  [NinA-tuma uJUMbe, ni-Ki-tA-ra-jia u-TAi-hisi.]
• I will show up anyway. - Nitaendelea kujitokeza, hata hivyo.  [Ni-ta-eNDE-lea ku-ji-to-keza, ha-ta Hi-vo.]
• I see a way through. - Naona njia ya kupitia.  [Na-Ona NJi-a ya ku-PITi-a.]
• Tonight, I choose calm hope. - Usiku huu, nachagua tumaini la utulivu.  [U-SI-ku huu, na-CHAGUA tuMAINi la u-tu-LIvu.]
• Even silence can hold hope. - Hata ukimya unaweza kuwa na tumaini.  [HA-ta u-KI-mya u-na-weza ku-wa na tuMAINi.]

CELEBRATIONS & PARTIES · Sherehe na Mikutano
• I brought fruit for the table. - Nimeleta matunda kwa mezani.  [NIME-le-ta MA-tu-nda kwa ME-za-ni.]
• Can we bless the food first? - Tunaweza kuomba baraka kwa chakula kwanza?  [TU-na-we-za ku-oMBA barA-ka kwa chaKU-la Kwanza?]
• Happy anniversary, karibu kusherehekea! - Her i ya miaka, karibu kusherehekea pamoja.  [H E-ri ya MI-a-ka, ka-BI-ku ku-SHE-re-he- ke-a paMO-ja.]
• Who is taking group photos? - Ni nani anapiga picha za pamoja?  [Ni NA-ni a-na-pi-ga PI-cha za paMO-ja?]
• Let me help with setup, please. - Nisaidie mpangilio kidogo, tafadhali.  [NI-SAA-die m-pan-GI-lio ki-dO-go, ta-faDHA-li.]
• Do we have halal options for drinks? - Kuna vinywaji vya halal hapa?  [KU-na viNYWA-ji vya HA-lal HA-pa?]

COURAGE · Ujasiri
• I’ll do it with shaky hands. - Nitaifanya hata mikono ikiwa inatetemeka,  [NITAifAHA hata MIKONo ikiwa INATEtemEKEA,]
• I can be scared and go anyway. - Ninaogopa, lakini naendelea hata hivyo,  [NINAogopa, lakini NAENDELEA hata HIVYO,]
• I won’t abandon my dreams. - Sitayaacha ndoto zangu,  [SITayaacha NDOTO ZANGU,]
• I’m choosing hard honesty today. - Leo ninachagua kusema ukweli mgumu,  [LEO ninachagua kusema UKWELI mgumu,]
• I’ll ask for help when it matters. - Nitaomba msaada inapohitajika,  [NITAomba MSAADA inapohitajika,]
